metaDescription: Six travertine-look coffee tables compared on veneer versus stone, weight, hollow core, shape, storage and clearance. None of these listings is solid stone.
expertTake: The 247 HOME low profile table is our top pick because its listing states a 14 in height, a 4 in under-table clearance and a veneer finish on engineered wood, which is honest about what it is. The Maotifeys round drum is the value pick for a fully assembled small table. Skip the category if you want real stone, because every table here is a travertine look in veneer, MDF or MgO, and solid travertine sits in a different class of price and weight.
introParagraphs: Travertine is a pale, banded natural stone that has become a signature of organic modern interiors, and real travertine tables are heavy, porous and expensive. The tables in this guide are travertine-look pieces: engineered wood or MgO board with a stone-inspired veneer or embossed finish. That makes them light, affordable and easy to move, and it also means they behave like laminate furniture, not like stone.

We evaluated each table from its published specifications and patterns in owner feedback, not from handling it. Listings use the word travertine for stone-look finishes, so we state the real material for each one. The lineup spans low rectangles, a sculptural cloud shape, a round drum and a storage table so you can match the shape to your room.

products.name: 247 HOME 47.3 in Faux Travertine Low-Profile Coffee Table, Recessed Base, 14 in High

specList.label: Dimensions
specList.value: 47.3 in W x 23 in D x 14 in H

specList.label: Finish
specList.value: Faux travertine veneer on engineered wood

products.description:
The 247 HOME is a 47.3 in low-profile rectangular coffee table, 23 in deep and 14 in high, with a recessed base that leaves 4 in of clearance underneath and a faux travertine veneer on engineered wood. The listing describes a hollow-core frame that is easy to reposition and states a static weight capacity. It is the best-documented table in the lineup and the clearest about its material.

The tradeoff is height and weight. At 14 in the table sits below the 16 to 18 in range of a typical sofa seat, so it reads very low, and a hollow core is light but not rugged. A veneer can chip at the edges, and a stone-look print will not have the depth of real banding. Compared with the ModernMate, it is lower and plainer but cleaner in line.

Assembly is minimal, and the recessed base lets a vacuum pass underneath. Use coasters and wipe spills quickly. It suits a modern living room with a low sofa where an organic, floating look is wanted.
products.bestFor: Modern living rooms with a low sofa that want a clean, floating travertine look.
pros: Listing is explicit that the finish is a veneer on engineered wood
Recessed base leaves 4 in of clearance for a vacuum or a robot
47.3 in length suits a standard sofa without crowding
Hollow-core frame is easy to move and reposition
cons: 14 in height is lower than most sofa seats and can feel too low
Veneer can chip at the edges and lacks the depth of real banding

products.name: Maotifeys 28.3 in Round Faux Travertine Drum Coffee Table, Fully Assembled

specList.label: Material
specList.value: MDF with light beige faux travertine finish

products.description:
The Maotifeys is a 28.3 in round drum coffee table in MDF with a light beige faux travertine finish that arrives fully assembled. The listing describes a simple round shape and natural stone pattern. It is the smallest and the simplest table in the lineup.

The tradeoff is the finish and the build. MDF with a printed pattern is the budget end of stone-look tables, and a drum shape has no legs, so a heavy load or a spilled drink falls on the same surface. The MDF swells if water soaks into an edge, and a drum can scuff a floor if dragged. Compared with the 247 HOME, it is smaller and cheaper but less raised from the floor.

Unbox it, place a felt pad underneath and use coasters. It suits a small apartment or a spot between two chairs where a solid, round, low-effort table is enough.
products.bestFor: Small apartments and chair corners that want a round table with no assembly.
pros: Arrives fully assembled, which saves time and avoids missing parts
28.3 in round shape fits small rooms and has no corners
Light beige finish suits organic modern and Scandinavian rooms
Drum body is solid and hard to tip
cons: MDF with a printed finish swells if water soaks into an edge
Drum shape has no legs and scuffs a floor if dragged

products.name: Patio Watcher 40 in Travertine-Look Rectangle Coffee Table, MgO Hollow Core
products.description:
The Patio Watcher is a 40 in rectangular coffee table in lightweight MgO with a hollow-core construction and a soft concrete-inspired travertine look in off-white. The listing says the hollow core still delivers a substantial presence. It is the only table here made of MgO, a mineral board, instead of wood.

The tradeoff is feel and repair. MgO is rigid and resists moisture better than MDF, but it can chip at corners, and a hollow core sounds hollow when tapped. A concrete-inspired texture is a different look from a banded stone, and the listing's text mixes descriptions of rectangular and round shapes, so check the exact dimensions on the page. Compared with the Maotifeys, it is larger and lighter but less sturdy at the edges.

Handle the corners when carrying it and wipe with a damp cloth. It suits a living room or a covered patio where a light, moisture-resistant, pale table is wanted.
products.bestFor: Living rooms and covered patios that want a light, moisture-resistant pale table.
pros: MgO resists moisture better than MDF and does not swell as readily
Hollow core makes the table easy to move around the room
Off-white concrete-style texture suits minimalist rooms
40 in width suits a loveseat or a small sofa
cons: Corners can chip, and a hollow core sounds hollow when tapped
Listing text mixes round and rectangular descriptions, so confirm the shape

products.name: ModernMate 47.2 in Travertine-Look Coffee Table, 2 Drawers, Open Shelf, Oak Finish

specList.label: Storage
specList.value: 2 drawers and a 43.2 in open shelf

products.description:
The ModernMate is a 47.2 in coffee table with a travertine-look top on a natural oak finish, two drawers and a 43.2 in open lower shelf. The listing says the drawers hide remotes and charging cables. It is the only table here with closed drawers.

The tradeoff is complexity. Drawers have slides that can stick or loosen, and an engineered-wood body can chip and swell. The travertine look is the top only, and the oak is a finish. Compared with the 247 HOME, it offers storage but sits higher and bulkier, and it does not float.

Check the drawer action on arrival and keep the load light. It suits a living room where a coffee table has to hide clutter as well as look organic.
products.bestFor: Living rooms that want a travertine look and drawers for remotes and cables.
pros: Two drawers hide remotes, cables and small clutter
43.2 in open shelf holds books, baskets and magazines
Oak finish warms the pale travertine-look top
47.2 in width suits a standard sofa
cons: Drawer slides can stick or loosen over time
Travertine look applies to the top only and the body is engineered wood

products.name: DM Furniture 35 in Faux Travertine Square Coffee Table, Recessed Plinth Base
products.description:
The DM Furniture is a 35 in square coffee table with a recessed plinth base and a 3D embossed beige travertine-inspired finish on engineered wood panels. The listing says the table is sculptural and architectural. It is the most monumental-looking table in the lineup.

The tradeoff is the corners and the assembly. A square table has sharp corners, and a 35 in square needs space, so it suits a large seating group more than a small room. An embossed surface adds texture but catches crumbs, and panels that screw together can loosen. Compared with the Maotifeys, it is bigger and more architectural but not round.

Assemble it on a flat floor and tighten the screws after a month. It suits a spacious living room where a solid, sculptural block is the centerpiece.
products.bestFor: Spacious living rooms that want a solid, sculptural square centerpiece.
pros: 35 in square plinth gives a substantial, architectural presence
3D embossed finish adds visible texture to the surface
Recessed base gives a floating look
Square shape suits two sofas facing each other
cons: Square corners are sharp and take space in a small room
Embossed finish catches crumbs and panel screws can loosen

products.name: Hyfirm 55 in Travertine-Look Cloud Coffee Table, Irregular Top, Walnut 3-Leg Base

specList.label: Dimensions
specList.value: 55 in W x 27.5 in D x 16 in H

products.description:
The Hyfirm is a 55 in cloud-shaped coffee table, 27.5 in deep and 16 in high, with an irregular, softly rounded MDF top in a travertine-inspired pattern on a walnut-finish three-leg base. The listing says the large top suits sofas and sectionals. It is the largest and the most sculptural top in the lineup.

The tradeoff is size and edges. A 55 in top needs a big room and a long sofa, and an irregular shape can look odd next to straight furniture. MDF with a printed pattern can swell at an edge if water sits on it. Compared with the 247 HOME, it is longer and higher and more organic, but also a stronger style statement.

Place it on a rug large enough to hold the legs. Use coasters and wipe spills. It suits a large living room with a sectional where an organic centerpiece is wanted.

pros: 55 in top is generous for a sectional or a long sofa
16 in height matches a typical sofa seat better than very low tables
Irregular cloud shape softens a room full of straight lines
Walnut-finish three-leg base adds warmth to the pale top
cons: Needs a big room and a long sofa to look balanced

buyingCriteria.explanation: A travertine-look table may be a veneer, a printed MDF surface or a mineral board, and it is not solid stone. The 247 HOME says veneer on engineered wood, the DM Furniture says 3D embossed finish and the Patio Watcher uses MgO. Real travertine is heavy, porous and needs sealing. If a listing never says stone, assume it is not. A real stone top would also come with a weight in the tens of pounds and a sealing instruction, and the absence of both is the clearest tell.

Hollow-core tables like the 247 HOME and Patio Watcher are light and easy to move, and they feel less solid than real stone. A light table can slide when bumped and can look hollow when tapped. Check the stated static weight capacity before placing a heavy tray or books. A decorative bowl and a stack of art books together can weigh more than you expect, and a hollow frame is where the limit is felt first.

A coffee table should sit within about an inch of the sofa seat, usually 16 to 18 in. The 247 HOME is 14 in and the Hyfirm 16 in. A very low table suits a low sofa and looks wrong beside a tall one. Measure your sofa seat first.

Round and cloud shapes, like the Maotifeys and Hyfirm, have no sharp corners, while rectangles and squares such as the DM Furniture have corners that bruise shins. Organic shapes suit open rooms and clash in narrow ones. Choose by how you walk through the room, and picture the route from the sofa to the door, since the corner of a square table is exactly where a hip or a shin finds it.

The 247 HOME leaves 4 in under the table, which lets a vacuum pass and gives a floating look. A drum base like the Maotifeys has no clearance. A recessed base also scuffs less. Check whether the base has floor protection pads, and add felt if it does not, because a hard base on wood or tile leaves marks within weeks.

Veneers and printed MDF chip at the edges and swell with water, while MgO resists moisture. Embossed surfaces catch crumbs. Use coasters and wipe spills quickly. Real stone needs sealing, but these tables do not, and a cleaner that is safe for stone, such as one with acid, is not always safe for a printed veneer. Stay with mild soap and water.

howWeEvaluated.title: Listing specifications
howWeEvaluated.description: We evaluated each table from the dimensions, material, finish and weight rating stated on its Amazon listing. We did not handle any of them. The 247 HOME's 14 in height and the Hyfirm's 55 in width are numbers we compare.

howWeEvaluated.title: Stone honesty
howWeEvaluated.description: We recorded what each tabletop really is, because every table here is a stone look. Where a listing used the word travertine without saying material, we note it. That is why the 247 HOME ranks first.

howWeEvaluated.title: On-topic filtering
howWeEvaluated.description: The topic search returned faux marble tables and a round marble veneer table. We kept travertine-look coffee tables. That left a lineup of six.

howWeEvaluated.title: Owner feedback patterns
howWeEvaluated.description: We considered recurring themes such as veneer chipping, hollow-core feel and embossed crumb traps. We do not repeat ratings or counts. A pattern counted only when it matched the described construction.

howWeEvaluated.title: Honest limits
howWeEvaluated.description: No listing here is solid stone, and none states a veneer thickness. We say so plainly. Treat every table as a stone-look piece.

howToChoose.subheading: Low Floating Table vs Table with Storage

cards.label: Low floating table
cards.text: The 247 HOME gives a clean line, clearance and an airy look. It has no storage.

cards.label: Table with storage
cards.text: The ModernMate hides clutter in drawers and a shelf. It looks bulkier.

howToChoose.note: Choose floating for a minimal room and storage for a busy household.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: Soft shapes, pale warm tones, a table within an inch of sofa height and honest labelling of the finish. Mix with wood and linen.

cards.label: In this comparison
cards.text: The Hyfirm and 247 HOME both suit organic modern rooms, with the Hyfirm more sculptural.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You want real travertine, a stone top that can be sealed and repaired and a heavy, stable base. Those sit in a different class from these listings.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: You want the look in a rental. A simple table like the Maotifeys covers that.

Slides stick or loosen. Keep loads light in the ModernMate drawers.
Pads protect floors and reduce sliding. Add them under the Maotifeys drum.

faq.q: What height should a coffee table be?
faq.a: Within about an inch of the sofa seat, usually 16 to 18 in. A 14 in table reads low.

faq.q: Are round tables better for small rooms?
faq.a: Yes, because they have no corners and move traffic smoothly. A cloud shape needs more room.

faq.q: How do I clean a veneer top?
faq.a: Wipe with a damp cloth and dry it. Avoid harsh cleaners and standing water.
